verdict.rationale: Kick documents a true double-entry ledger in which every transaction generates a journal entry with a debit and a credit side. The evidence only describes entries generated automatically from bank, payroll, and bill transactions, not an accountant manually posting entries. Notes can be added to transactions, which loosely covers supporting memos. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of manual journal entry creation, multi-line balancing enforcement, memo fields on journal entries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
